verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented setting or policy that lets users opt out of having their code and prompts used for model training. BYOK, local models via Ollama/LM Studio, and the option to self-host are adjacent workarounds that may limit data exposure, but they are not a training opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
